name: camayoc_effective_work_priority
description: priority-inheritance Q1/Q2: minimum declared priority over a work item and its active blocking dependents. Reads explicit project plus its companion; no priority is rewritten. Rule-derived activeBlocks supplies closure. Reconcile/freshness required before use; absent/failed query is UNKNOWN.
template: SELECT ?item (MIN(?rank) AS ?effectivePriority) FROM <{project}> FROM <{inferred}> WHERE { ?item a <https://schema.org/Action> . { ?item <https://seeds.local/ontology/priority> ?rank } UNION { ?item <https://seeds.local/ontology/activeBlocks> ?root . ?root <https://seeds.local/ontology/priority> ?rank } } GROUP BY ?item

params.name: inferred
params.description: That project graph's companion inferred graph; consumers must verify the pairing.
